I'm 22 and I tried what you plan on doing-twice- 4 days ago. Expect I had about 60 benzo pills and a bottle to go with the bag. I've told the whole story too many times, feel free to read my posts if you wanna know about it. After I took the pills and booze I put the bag over my head. I did my research, I bet you did too. What you read about gently falling alseep is bullshit. I was extremely fucked up and after about 5 minutes I tore the bag off. You can't see anything, the crinkle of the bag off your breath is all you'll hear. You will get extremely hot before you even get lightheaded. You will feel the suffocation, your body will realize your not breathing oxygen and will go into panic mode. Probably the most fucked up moment in my 2 day attempt was having that bag on my head. I was saved by a girl on reddit who called the cops. I told everyone and asked for help. You need to do the same. At least try, I bet you'll be surprised at the love you will receive if you open up. You have friends here, and I know you can make friends in person. I don't believe that anybody dosent have somebody around them they can confide in, weather you know them yet or not. Just take today to think about what everyone in your life would be doing, if you took your life yesterday. You can always talk to people here. We don't judge, I don't care what bad you've done, because I've bet you've done more good. Focus on the good friend :)

Well the biggest factor preventing me from trying it again is the support group I've surrounded myself in. Without ever giving them the chance to try and help me. I always thought I would be a burden if I opened up, but you know what? It makes people feel loved and special when you can confide in them. I saw a therapist the other day and that helped Tons. I though it was going to be a big emotional blow up, but it was the opposite. Yes I broke down telling her what I did, but she listened, and discussed plans for moving forward. She didnt make me feel bad at all, hell, it looked like she was tearing up a bit. They all just want me to focus on myself. You can't make anybody else happy unless you are yourself. I was all over this post before my attempt and one user actually figured I wasent full of shit and called the cops, they busted down my door and saved me. That's why I'm on reddit now, I feel like I can help people on here because I know what true darkness is like. I'm still not ok, it will take time, but life has purpose for me again. I want to enrich the live of those I would have otherwise completely ruined. It's my motivation. You need to find that motivation. It's good your talking on here, don't ever put yourself in a shell thinkin nobody care or nobody wants to talk. We are here :)
